init.description: Polling interval, the occupancy reduction, and the crowding thresholds. The portal's reported count overstates real occupancy, so the Real Occupancy sensor reduces it by the reduction percentage. Busyness compares that estimate against each club's floor area: 0.8 people/16m² is one person per 20 m², 1.6 is one per 10 m². Floor area and staffed hours are set per club in clubs.yaml.

error.thresholds_inverted: The crowded threshold must be at least the busy threshold.
